messages:
maria: quick check — trying to merge #4521 (token-cost attribution) but CI is failing on the telemetry tests, blocking the rollout. anyone seen this exact failure? PR: https://git.redwood/infra/pr/4521
kevin: link + error please? can take a look if it's flaky or a real schema mismatch
maria: failing test snippet below:
```
E   AssertionError: missing field 'latency_bucket_ms' in event payload
telemetry/event_schema_test.py::test_latency_fields
Logs: https://ci.redwood/job/4521/15/console
```
kevin: hm looks like the recent embeddings-runner change renamed a field. sasha, did the attr pipeline rename land in prod yesterday? :thinking_face:
sasha: yes that change went in — we renamed latency_ms -> latency_bucket_ms in the ingest shim to support histogram buckets. I thought we updated the event schema contract too but maybe not everywhere.
raj: pinging the owner of the test. If the schema contract change is intentional we should either: (1) update tests + downstream consumers, or (2) add a compatibility shim in the pipeline. which route do we want for this sprint?
maria: PR was intended to be additive but the test assumes the old name. prefer short fix to unblock merge — update the test and open a follow-up to normalize names across consumers.
olivia: dashboards might break if the field name differs. quick sanity: does the metrics pipeline accept both keys? if not we need a migrate plan, not just test tweaks.
sasha: current metrics pipeline only reads `latency_bucket_ms`. the old key is ignored. so dashboards reading the old field will break.
deploy-bot: CI summary for job 4521: 1 failed test suite (telemetry), 0 flaky markers. Full run time 7m 32s. https://ci.redwood/job/4521/15
kevin: ok short plan: (a) update test in PR to assert `latency_bucket_ms` (b) open an issue to add a small compatibility mapper that copies latency_ms -> latency_bucket_ms for 2 weeks, and notify consumer teams + dashboards. I can draft the issue.
maria: I can push the test update now. tagging @raj for review since you own the token-attrib infra.
raj: happy to review, please include a note in the commit message referencing the compatibility issue number once we open it. also add a quick smoke check script so dashboards owners can run locally.
maria: pushed test fix: https://git.redwood/infra/pr/4521/files#diff-7a8. will rerun CI.
deploy-bot: CI triggered for PR 4521 (run 16).
kevin: I'll open the compat issue and assign sasha + platform-observability. draft will include rollout window and migration checklist.
olivia: can you add which dashboards to validate? cc @analytics-team. we should list the main token-cost + latency dashboards.
sasha: noted — I'll enumerate dashboards and add smoke queries.
maria: CI passed on run 16 :tada: merging after raj's quick review. thanks everyone.
raj: quick review done, LGTM. merging. :shipit:
kevin: follow-up items: issue #4780 (compat mapper), smoke script PR, dashboard validation doc. i'll create the tickets and ping owners.
maria: thanks — leaving this thread open for any fallout. :thumbsup:
